description: 08-oligodendroglioma-pending - regenerated 2026-09-19 for the shared CNS diagnosis core: the glioma path now takes the four layers from schemas/_cns_layers.json (Layer 2 histopathological classification and the branched Layer 4 panel replace the flat glioma feature, immunohistochemistry and molecular lists), so the same tumour reads identically on the biopsy and on the resection.
report:
Brain, right frontal lesion, stereotactic biopsy

Two smear preparations are made from the tissue. They show monomorphic cells with rounded nuclei lying against delicate branching capillaries. Sections show three pieces of tissue comprising a diffusely infiltrating glial neoplasm composed of cells with uniform rounded nuclei and perinuclear haloes set in a delicate branching capillary network. The tumour shows rounded nuclei with perinuclear haloes, a delicate branching capillary network and microcalcification. Mitoses are not identified in 10 high-power fields. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for GFAP and OLIG2. The Ki-67 proliferation index is approximately 4 per cent. Molecular studies have been requested and the results are pending.

BRAIN, right frontal lobe, stereotactic biopsy - OLIGODENDROGLIOMA, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted, CNS WHO grade pending
- Histological appearance: diffuse glioma with oligodendroglial morphology, showing rounded nuclei with perinuclear haloes, a delicate branching capillary network and microcalcification
- Histopathological classification: oligodendroglioma
- Immunohistochemistry: GFAP positive; OLIG2 positive
- Molecular parameters: requested, result pending
- CNS WHO grade: pending

Molecular studies have been requested; the integrated diagnosis and CNS WHO grade will be issued in a supplementary report.
